title: Mean of a sign-valued function
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $g:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$ take only the values $-1$ and $1$, and let $m\ge 1$ be an integer such that $|\Omega|=2^m$. There is an integer $z$ for which the uniform mean of $g$ is $z\,2(2^{-1})^m$.
hypotheses_covered: $m$ is a nonnegative integer with $1\le m$
